shared_elements: incised marks on a stone surface (figural relief in A; possible inscription-like ruled lines in B)
justification: A depicts a detailed narrative scene: a chariot with horses in profile, an archer drawing a bow, spoked wheel, and fallen figures beneath, rendered in low relief with fine incised outlines. B shows an eroded rock face with vertical fissures and faint ruled horizontal striations but no identifiable figures, animals or motifs, so there is essentially no shared depicted content beyond both being worked/marked stone.
